notes:
I couldn't do this research. My first attempt to fetch the sources was refused with the message "You have no more code_execution tool calls remaining this turn." That's my only way to reach the web, and no pages loaded, so I have no notes for Job 10.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, give a URL for every point, and never fill gaps from my own knowledge. So I haven't written any commentary from memory.

When the tool is available again, ask me and I'll start with these pages:

- **Enduring Word (Pentecostal):** https://enduringword.com/bible-commentary/job-10/
- **Gill:** https://biblehub.com/commentaries/gill/job/10.htm
- **Ellicott:** https://biblehub.com/commentaries/ellicott/job/10.htm
- **Pulpit Commentary:** https://biblehub.com/commentaries/pulpit/job/10.htm
- **Barnes:** https://biblehub.com/commentaries/barnes/job/10.htm
- **NET Bible notes (modern scholarship):** https://netbible.org/bible/Job+10

After those, I'd search the other allowed sites:

- **Precept Austin:** its Job 10 page.
- **Wesley:** his Explanatory Notes on wesley.nnu.edu.
- **Reformed and Baptist teachers:** Ligonier, Desiring God and Grace to You, on Job's complaint and God shaping him in the womb (vv. 8–12).
- **Catholic and Orthodox:** New Advent, Catholic.com and OCA, on what Job 10 says about suffering and the afterlife.
- **Popular modern teaching:** any discussion of Job in prosperity or word-of-faith debates, as described on the allowed sites.
